params.help_doc: Client full name. Master record — everything links back here.
Internal notes about this client. Onboarding status is tracked in the Onboarding app.
Meta Business Portfolio ID. Found in Meta Business Suite → Settings → Business info.
Client's total monthly Facebook ad spend. Does NOT include our management fee.
Full URL of client's Facebook Page used for running ads. Confirm this is the CORRECT page before campaign build.
Slack channel ID for n8n notifications (format: C0XXXXXXXXX). Check #team-tasks for the ID.
Ask client to go to Meta Business Suite > Settings > Business Portfolio > Add People > add your agency email with full access. Mark Complete once you can see their Portfolio in your Business Manager.

Confirm the client's ad account appears in your Meta Business Manager under Ad Accounts. If not visible, ask client to share it from their Business Settings > Ad Accounts > Add People. Mark Complete once visible.
Confirm client's Facebook Business Page is linked and you have Page editor access. Go to Meta Business Suite > Pages and check it appears. Mark Complete once confirmed.
Verify client's Instagram account is connected to their Facebook Page. In Meta Business Suite > Settings > Instagram accounts. If not connected, ask client to link it. Mark Complete once connected.
Confirm the "Leads Access" or "Meta Ads" app is installed in client's ad account. Check in Meta Business Suite > Apps. Required for lead form integration. Mark Complete once confirmed.

Go to Meta Lead Centre using client's ad account. Confirm you can see lead form submissions. If blocked, ask client to grant Lead Access in Business Settings > Integrations. Mark Complete once you can see leads.

Set up email notifications so client is alerted instantly when a new lead comes in. In Meta Ads Manager > Lead Forms > select each form > Notifications > add client's email. Mark Complete once notifications are configured.

Connect Meta Lead Centre to client's CRM (e.g. GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Google Sheets). Use Zapier or native integration. Test by submitting a test lead form. Mark Complete once test lead appears in CRM.
Confirm with client exactly where leads are going (specific CRM, inbox, spreadsheet). Get written confirmation. Mark Complete once client confirms they are receiving leads at the correct destination.

Final check — verify the full lead pipeline is working end to end: Lead Form > Meta Lead Centre > CRM > Client notification. Submit a test lead if needed. Mark Complete once full pipeline is confirmed working.

Send the Video Brief template to client (find it in Google Drive > RequityAI > Resources > Video Brief Template). Explain they need to record 3-5 talking head videos addressing different distressed seller situations (probate, foreclosure, inheritance, code violations). Mark Complete once brief is sent.

Client has sent back recorded videos. Download them to the client's Google Drive folder (Drive > Clients > [Client Name] > Videos > Raw). Confirm video quality: clear audio, good lighting, at least 60 seconds each. Mark Complete once at least 3 videos are downloaded.
Videos have been edited, formatted for ads, and are ready to upload to the ad library. Mark Complete once creative assets are finalized and campaign-ready.
All 3 campaign build tasks (TOF, MOF, BOF) are complete. System sets this automatically when all 3 Tasks are marked Complete. DO NOT manually change this.

Final quality check before going live. Verify: correct audiences attached to each campaign, creative is approved, ad copy matches the SOP, campaign budgets set correctly, pixel is firing. Mark Complete once all checks pass.

Campaign has been activated in Meta Ads Manager and is now running. Check that ads are in Approved or Active status (not In Review or Rejected). Confirm with Andrew. Mark Complete once campaigns are confirmed Live.

Campaign is live. Send Andrew a Slack message with: client name, launch date, ad account ID, and links to all 3 campaigns in Meta Ads Manager. Andrew will notify the client. Mark Complete once Andrew is notified. ⚡ This triggers system to mark Onboarding Complete + set Client Status = Active.

Automatically set by system when Launch Notification step is marked Complete. DO NOT manually change. When this is Complete, the client appears as Active in the Clients app and the onboarding process is finished.
Campaign name. Format: "[Client Name] — [TOF/MOF/BOF]".
Building = VA setting up. Active = live and running. Paused = temporarily stopped. Needs Review = performance issue flagged.
TOF = cold video ad targeting distressed seller interests. MOF = retargets video viewers. BOF = retargets lead form openers and completers.
Total daily budget across all ad sets in this campaign (USD). Pull from Meta Ads Manager.
The Campaign ID from Meta Ads Manager. Go to Ads Manager > Campaigns > copy the ID. Required for reporting.
Date the campaign went live. Set this when you move Status from Building to Active.
The client this campaign belongs to. Click to open their full Clients record.

CAMPAIGN 1: TOF | EDU VIDEO — VIDEO VIEWS / THRUPLAY

Open Ads Manager in the correct client ad account
Click Create
Choose Video Views / ThruPlay objective
Set Special Ad Category = Housing
Name the campaign: TOF | EDU VIDEO | [MARKET] (use Campaign Name Auto formula)
Turn Campaign Budget Optimization / Advantage+ campaign budget OFF
Create one ad set per approved video
Set each ad set to $10/day unless client specifies otherwise
Set geography to the approved client market
Placements: Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, Facebook Video Feeds
Name each ad set using Ad Set Name Auto formula
Create one ad inside each ad set
Upload the correct approved recorded video
Use the correct Facebook Page and Instagram identity
Use light primary text only
CTA: Comment OPTIONS / DM OPTIONS
Run QA: correct name, correct video, correct identity, correct geo, correct budget, Special Ad Category = Housing, CBO off, placements correct
Publish

CAMPAIGN 2: MOF | RETARGET

Open Ads Manager and click Create
Name the campaign: MOF | RETARGET | [MARKET]
Set Special Ad Category = Housing
Build hot-viewer ad set: VV75-95 | 30-60D
Build engagers ad set: ENGAGERS | 30-90D (FB Page + IG + messaging engagers)
Build form-openers ad set ONLY if that audience exists: FORM OPENERS | 30D
Exclude LEAD | Form Submitted | 180D from all ad sets
Use more direct creative than Campaign 1 — proof, urgency, options framing
Name each ad: [Pain Angle] | Retarget | V1
Publish

CAMPAIGN 3: BOF | LEADS

Open Ads Manager and click Create
Choose Leads objective
Choose Instant Form as conversion location
Name the campaign: BOF | LEADS | [MARKET]
Set Special Ad Category = Housing
Build only hot warm audiences: VV95 | 30D, VV75 | 90D, FORM OPEN NO SUBMIT | 30D
Exclude submitted leads
Create the Instant Form with fields: Full name, Phone, Email, Property address, Timeline to sell, Situation dropdown
Use Higher Intent form type if lead quality needs tightening
Name each ad: [Pain Angle] | Lead Ad | V1
Publish
Submit a test lead and confirm it reaches the client CRM or Leads Center

FINAL RULE: Andrew/client chooses which videos run. The VA does not choose videos. The VA builds, launches, checks, and tracks only what is approved.
System-generated task name. Format: "[Task Type] — [Client Name]". Do not rename.
Complete this task by this date. Work oldest-due-date first. If blocked, update Blocker Reason and message Andrew in Slack.
What kind of task this is. Determines what you need to do. See the Tasks app description (ⓘ icon in the sidebar) for full breakdown of each task type.
Which client this task belongs to. Click to open their Clients record — find Ad Account ID and FB Page URL here.
The campaign this task relates to. Click to open the Campaigns record where you will enter Campaign IDs when the build is done.
The client this campaign belongs to. Click to open their full Clients record.
